nutshell.headline: 4 new Settings failures from a QA MongoDB authorization error on dk-system-user-rest — infra, not a code change.
nutshell.causeText: All 4 new failures share one QA environment fault: dk-system-user-rest returns HTTP 500 because MongoDB rejects it with error 13 'Authorization failure' on nexus-api-mongo-qa — an infra/credential issue, not a product code regression.
nutshell.investigation: Real messages show all 4 Settings /userSettings failures are the same MongoDB 'Authorization failure' (error 13) on the QA cluster, and no in-window QA deploy touches Mongo auth for dk-system-user-rest.
bullets: 4× Settings /userSettings → HTTP 500 from dk-system-user-rest, root cause MongoDB error 13 'Authorization failure' on nexus-api-mongo-qa (infra).
Contract drift (2 new, separate lane): 500 on /userSettings not defined in the OpenAPI contract — a side effect of the same outage.

detail.investigation: All 4 new failures are the View/Set user-settings tests hitting /userSettings, which return HTTP 500 because dk-system-user-rest cannot authorize against MongoDB (error 13 'Authorization failure' on nexus-api-mongo-qa) — an environment/credential fault, not a test/data or product regression. Of the QA deploys in-window only ST-4998 (krisztian.kover) touched dk-system-user-rest, changing just the QA health-check URL (group_vars/qa.yml), which cannot cause a Mongo authorization failure, so no code change is blamed.
bullets: 4× Settings: GET/PUT /userSettings → HTTP 500 from dk-system-user-rest; underlying error MongoDB 'Command failed with error 13: Authorization failure' on nexus-api-mongo-qa.
No in-window QA deploy maps to Mongo auth for dk-system-user-rest; ST-4998 (krisztian.kover) only edited dk-system-user-rest/group_vars/qa.yml (health-check URL) — not a plausible cause.
Contract drift (2 new, separate lane): 500 on /u1/users/currentUser/userSettings and /u1/users/{userId}/userSettings not defined in the OpenAPI contract — a side effect of these 500s.
